palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search for a page or an action to run.
state.error.title: Something went wrong
instance.dialog.title: New instance
instance.dialog.modeHint.create: ModManager creates the folders and the profile.json.
instance.dialog.modeHint.link: Nothing is written into the folder you link.
error.invalidInput: The input was rejected as invalid.
error.packChanged: The pack file changed after the plan was shown. Show the plan again before installing.
error.instanceChanged: The instance changed after the export plan was shown. Show the plan again before exporting.
error.noInstanceLock: This instance has no lock file yet: ModManager has not recorded anything as installed here, so there is nothing to export.
error.emptyExport: The pack would be empty: no locked project could be resolved and no override folder was chosen.
error.notFound: The requested item was not found.
error.providerApi: The mod provider rejected the request.
error.providerUnauthorized: A CurseForge API key is required or was rejected. Open Settings, add a valid key, and try again.
error.unsupported: The mod provider does not support this operation.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
error.io: A file or network operation failed.
error.linkOrReparse: A link or junction was found where the file would be written. Remove it, or choose a different folder, and try again.
error.newerSchema: This data was written by a newer version of the app.
error.cancelled: The install was stopped by your request. Files that already landed stay in place.
error.busy: Another install is already running. Wait for it to finish, or stop it first.
error.databaseBusy: The database is busy: another copy of the app or another program is using it. Close it and try again.
error.migrationFailed: The database could not be upgraded, so the app stopped before starting. Your data was not changed; the details show the stage and the schema versions.
error.startupDetailUnavailable: The details of this failure could not be shown: they could not be redacted safely, so they were withheld rather than displayed. The log records that this happened.
error.restoreMismatch: This backup is not the one the plan was built for, or the instance changed since. Build the plan again before restoring.
error.backupChanged: The backup's manifest changed after the plan was shown. Show the plan again before restoring.
error.notOurExport: This archive is not an export ModManager wrote: its manifest is missing or unreadable. If this is a Modrinth pack from somewhere else, install it with the pack installer instead.

settings.providers.roaming: On Windows this file lives under %APPDATA%, a folder that may roam with the profile or sync to the cloud. Do not save a key you would not move between machines.

settings.paths.note: These paths belong to this machine. The database is local and is not synced with the roaming profile.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
settings.legacy.title: Old application data
settings.legacy.body: Read the old application's database and its profile.json and installed_mods.json files to see what a future import could use. The scan is read-only: it imports nothing and writes nothing into the old folder.
settings.legacy.homePlaceholder: Leave empty to discover it automatically
settings.legacy.notScanned: Not scanned yet. A scan changes nothing.
settings.legacy.source.none: No old application folder was found
settings.legacy.database.unsupported: Newer than supported — profiles will not be read
settings.legacy.warning.root_not_found: No old application folder was found.

settings.legacy.warning.db_version_unsup: The database is newer than this app supports; its rows were not read.
settings.legacy.warning.profile_root_mis: This profile's root could not be resolved or does not exist.
settings.legacy.warning.profile_json_unr: profile.json is present but not valid.
settings.legacy.warning.installed_mods_u: installed_mods.json is present but not valid.

settings.legacy.backup: Backup of this app's database, taken before the import
settings.legacy.noBackup: No rows were written, so no backup was needed.

details.staleHint: Content may be stale - files changed on disk.

details.updates.title: Updates
details.updates.readOnly: Read-only check: nothing is downloaded and nothing is written to the instance folder.
details.updates.needsTarget: A check needs this instance's Minecraft version and loader; one of them is unknown.
details.updates.nothing: No files are recorded for this provider in this instance.
details.updates.installDeferred: Installing updates automatically is not available yet; this preview only shows what exists.
details.updates.warn.unsupported: This provider has no hash lookup, so these files cannot be judged.
details.updates.warn.emptyLock: There is no lock file yet: ModManager has not recorded anything as installed in this instance.
details.updates.warn.lockUnreadable: The lock file could not be read; it is unreadable or corrupt.
details.classTip.externalUnknown: No managed record matches this file by SHA-1 or by project and version, so this app did not install it and cannot say where it came from.
details.duplicateKeys: Shared identity with another file in this folder
details.compat.unproven: Compatibility cannot be proven from the metadata this file declares.
details.compat.range: The provider recorded a version range, which this build cannot judge yet, so compatibility is unknown.
details.compat.noTarget: This instance has no Minecraft version or loader set, so compatibility cannot be judged.
details.warn.managedHashMismatch: <token>{{name}}</token> no longer matches the SHA-1 the lock records; it changed after it was installed.
details.warn.duplicateLocalIdentity.sha1: Two or more files have identical bytes (same SHA-1): <token>{{key}}</token>
details.warn.duplicateLocalIdentity.proj: Two or more files belong to the same project in different versions: <token>{{key}}</token>
remove.title: Remove selected files
remove.description: Nothing is deleted permanently. The selected files are moved into a dated backup folder inside this instance's mods folder.
remove.backupNote: Backup folder: .modrinth_bulk_downloader_removed_content/<timestamp>/ inside mods/. remove_manifest.json records what moved.
remove.count: {{allowed}} will be moved · {{refused}} will be left alone.
remove.nothingAllowed: Nothing in this selection can be moved. Close the dialog and choose another file.
remove.externalWarning: {{count}} selected files are not recorded in this instance's lock file. Type REMOVE to confirm moving them to the backup folder.
remove.externalWarning_one: {{count}} selected file is not recorded in this instance's lock file. Type REMOVE to confirm moving it to the backup folder.
remove.externalWarning_other: {{count}} selected files are not recorded in this instance's lock file. Type REMOVE to confirm moving them to the backup folder.
remove.externalRow: External or unknown — typed confirmation required.
remove.confirmHint: This word is required only because at least one selected file is external or unknown.
remove.manifestFailed: The files moved, but the remove manifest could not be written; the backup folder may be missing its record.
remove.reason.moved-to-backup: The file is now in the backup folder.
remove.reason.outside: Source file is outside the active profile mods folder.
remove.reason.backup-folder: Remove backup folders cannot be selected for removal.
remove.reason.unsupported: Only local .jar or .jar.disabled files can be removed in this phase.
remove.reason.backup-exists: Local backup destination already exists; nothing was overwritten.
remove.reason.backup-unwritable: Could not create the backup folder.
remove.reason.backup-outside: Backup destination is outside the remove backup folder.
pack.emptyBody: Pick a .mrpack file and an instance, then show the plan before installing.
pack.noInstancesBody: Create an instance first on the Instances page; a pack installs into an existing one.
pack.planNote: Nothing is written yet. Core rebuilds the plan on confirm and never takes it from this screen.
pack.import.title: Import an exported pack
pack.import.body: Reads the manifest of one of ModManager's own exports first: nothing is created or written until you confirm the folder and the name.
pack.import.previewNote: Metadata only: nothing was extracted or created. The archive is re-checked against the manifest when you import.
pack.import.result: Imported {{written}} files, {{skipped}} already in place, {{size}} in total.
export.title: Export as .mrpack
export.body: Builds a Modrinth pack from this instance's recorded content and the folders you choose. Nothing is written until you save.
export.field.name: Pack name
export.folders.empty: This instance has no top-level folders besides the recorded files.
export.folders.failed: The folder list could not be read.
export.planNote: Nothing is written yet. Saving re-plans against the instance and refuses a lock that changed since this preview.
export.skippedNote: These projects are pinned in the instance lock but cannot be re-downloaded from Modrinth, so they are not part of this pack.
export.excludedNote: These local paths are never packed: logs, caches, credentials and links.
backup.title: Backup
backup.body: A dated copy of this instance's mods, config and metadata, written inside the instance folder. Your live files are only read.
backup.includeSavesHint: Off by default: worlds can be much larger than the rest of the instance, and restoring them replaces your current saves.
backup.skipped.title: Not copied
backup.list.empty: No backup of this instance yet.
worlds.title: Worlds
worlds.body: A read-only inventory of what is under saves/. Nothing here is opened for writing, moved or restored.
worlds.no-saves: This instance has no saves folder.
worlds.empty: saves/ exists but holds no world.
worlds.read-only: Read-only inventory: datapacks and level.dat are counted, nothing is changed.
worlds.column.name: World
restore.title: Restore this backup
restore.description: Review what will be copied back before anything is written. Your current files are moved aside first, never overwritten.
restore.count: {{allowed}} will be restored — {{blocked}} will be left alone.
restore.nothingAllowed: Nothing in this backup can be restored into this instance.
restore.includeSavesHint: Off by default: your current worlds stay untouched unless you tick this.
restore.noSavesInBackup: This backup was made without worlds, so there is nothing to restore there.
restore.safetyNote: Before each copy, the current target is moved here, and a failed group is rolled back from it.
restore.blockedNote: Blocked rows are shown so nothing is restored silently.
restore.confirmHint: Nothing is written until this word matches.
restore.outcome.partial: Some groups failed and were rolled back. The safety folder keeps what was moved aside.
restore.outcome.cancelled: The restore was stopped. Groups already restored stay in place, and the safety folder keeps the previous files.
restore.state.rollback-failed: Failed, and the safety copy could not be put back
restore.reason.allowed: Will be restored after you confirm.
restore.reason.profile-not-restored: profile.json is never restored: the app's database row is the truth and regenerates this mirror.
restore.reason.source-missing: This group is not in the backup.
restore.reason.entry-is-link: The backup holds a link here; links are never copied back.
restore.reason.saves-blocked-by-default: Worlds are left alone unless you tick the option above.
restore.reason.entry-outside-group: The manifest records a path outside this group, so the whole group is refused.
restore.reason.safety-exists: A safety copy already exists for this group; move it away first.
restore.reason.target-under-link: The target sits behind a link, so nothing is written through it.
restore.reason.dependency-failed: Skipped because the mods were not restored.
restore.reason.backup-outside: The entry points outside the selected backup.
restore.reason.safety-outside: The plan names a safety folder outside the instance, so nothing was moved.
restore.reason.move-aside-failed: The current target could not be moved aside.
restore.reason.safety-unwritable: The safety folder could not be created.
restore.reason.read-failed: A file could not be read.
restore.reason.write-failed: A file could not be written.
restore.reason.hash-mismatch: A copied file did not match the manifest hash, so the group was rolled back.
restore.reason.unrecorded-file: The backup holds a file the manifest does not record, so the group was refused.
restore.pending.body: Files moved aside by that restore are still here: {{groups}}. Nothing was repaired automatically.
